purpose: Scientifically calibrated journal setting; not an exact numerical reproduction of SIGIR 2024.

participation.proxy: exp(-minimum historical distance / robust distance scale)

quality.proxy: robustly normalized log historical in-region check-in count

demand.calibration: global median positive direct capacity of the candidate pool
demand.selection_rationale: rho=1.50 selected after strong-baseline recalibration with ObjCovGreedy and CELF; at k=50 CELF saturation is about 0.14 on Gowalla and 0.07 on Brightkite while random remains far below strong methods.

oracle.monte_carlo_protocol: fixed live-edge worlds for repeatable queries
canonical_ec_order: estimate node activation probabilities across worlds
apply demand clipping once to expected coverage

training_baseline.rationale: Match the conference training budget for the first scientifically calibrated baseline before changing the learning algorithm.
